actinic_keratosis.prevalence: Common in fair-skinned people over 40; ~40% of light-skinned adults
actinic_keratosis.global_rate: Affects millions worldwide, particularly in sunny climates

basal_cell_carcinoma.prevalence: Most common skin cancer; ~2-3 million cases/year in US alone
basal_cell_carcinoma.global_rate: 80% of all skin cancers are BCC
basal_cell_carcinoma.at_risk: Fair skin, sun exposure, age, immunosuppression

darier_disease.prevalence: Rare genetic disorder affecting ~1 in 100,000 people

dermatofibroma.prevalence: Very common benign growth, affects ~1% of adults
dermatofibroma.at_risk: History of insect bites or minor injuries

epidermolysis_bullosa.prevalence: Rare genetic condition affected ~500,000 people worldwide

herpes_simplex.prevalence: Extremely common - ~67% of world population under 50 carries HSV-1

impetigo.prevalence: Very common in children aged 2-5 years
impetigo.at_risk: Children, crowded settings, poor hygiene, hot climates

larva_migrans.global_rate: Millions at risk in warm climates
larva_migrans.at_risk: Barefoot walking, tropical beaches, contaminated soil

leprosy.global_rate: Endemic in parts of Asia, Africa, South America
leprosy.at_risk: Prolonged close contact, low immunity, endemic regions

lichen_planus.gender: Males slightly more for skin, females for oral form

lupus.at_risk: Women, certain ethnicities, family history, sun exposure

melanoma.at_risk: Fair skin, sunburns, moles, family history, tanning beds

molluscum_contagiosum.prevalence: Common in children; affects ~1-2% of population

pediculosis_capitis.global_rate: Millions affected worldwide, especially school children
pediculosis_capitis.at_risk: School children, shared items, close contact

psoriasis.prevalence: Affects ~2-3% of world population (125+ million people)
psoriasis.at_risk: Family history, stress, infections, smoking, alcohol

seborrheic_keratosis.prevalence: Extremely common - affects virtually everyone over 50
seborrheic_keratosis.global_rate: Most common benign skin tumor in adults

squamous_cell_carcinoma.prevalence: Second most common skin cancer; ~1 million cases/year in US
squamous_cell_carcinoma.at_risk: Sun exposure, fair skin, chronic wounds, immunosuppression

tinea_corporis.global_rate: ~20-25% of world population affected by fungal infections
tinea_corporis.at_risk: Contaminated animals, hot humid climates, shared items

tinea_nigra.at_risk: Tropical climates, soil contact, barefoot gardening

tungiasis.prevalence: Endemic in parts of Caribbean, South America, Africa
tungiasis.global_rate: Millions at risk in endemic regions
tungiasis.peak_age: Children and adults in endemic areas
tungiasis.at_risk: Barefoot walking, sandy soils, poverty, endemic areas

vascular_lesion.prevalence: Common - many people have some form

nevus.peak_age: Moles develop through childhood and adolescence

healthy_normal.global_rate: Majority of population has healthy skin

acne.prevalence: Very common - most common skin condition worldwide
acne.global_rate: ~85% of people aged 12-24 experience some acne; adults too
acne.gender: More in teenage males; adult acne more common in women
acne.at_risk: Hormonal changes, oily skin, family history, stress

hyperpigmentation.prevalence: Very common across all skin types
hyperpigmentation.global_rate: Melasma affects ~1-5% of people; dark spots very widespread
hyperpigmentation.at_risk: Sun exposure, pregnancy/hormones, post-inflammatory marks, darker skin tones

eczema.prevalence: Very common - affects ~10-20% of children, 1-3% of adults
eczema.gender: Slightly more in boys in childhood

urticaria.prevalence: Very common - ~20% of people experience hives at some point
urticaria.at_risk: Allergic people, recent infections, new medicines

contact_dermatitis.prevalence: Very common - most common occupational skin disease

alopecia.prevalence: Common - male pattern affects up to 50% of men by age 50
alopecia.at_risk: Family history, stress, iron deficiency, post-illness

nail_fungus.at_risk: Athelete's foot, diabetes, swimming pools, tight shoes

scabies.at_risk: Close contact living, nursing homes, shared bedding

vasculitis.gender: Both; some types more in men

bullous_disease.global_rate: Few cases per million in autoimmune type
bullous_disease.at_risk: Genetic types in infants, autoimmune tendency

drug_eruption.prevalence: Common - most people see minor rashes with some medicines

systemic_disease.global_rate: Wide range - common for deficiency types
systemic_disease.at_risk: Diabetes, thyroid disease, poor nutrition, chronic illness
